+package database
+
+import (
+	"context"
+	"database/sql"
+	"errors"
+	"net"
+	"strings"
+
+	"github.com/gravitational/trace"
+	mssql "github.com/microsoft/go-mssqldb"
+	"github.com/microsoft/go-mssqldb/msdsn"
+
+	"github.com/gravitational/teleport/lib/defaults"
+)
+
+// SQLServerPinger implements database connection checks for SQL Server.
+type SQLServerPinger struct{}
+
+// Ping connects to SQL Server and checks that the requested login and database work.
+func (p *SQLServerPinger) Ping(ctx context.Context, params PingParams) error {
+	if err := params.CheckAndSetDefaults(defaults.ProtocolSQLServer); err != nil {
+		return trace.Wrap(err)
+	}
+	if params.Port < 0 || params.Port > 65535 {
+		return trace.BadParameter("invalid SQL Server port %d", params.Port)
+	}
+
+	connector := mssql.NewConnectorConfig(msdsn.Config{
+		Host:       params.Host,
+		Port:       uint64(params.Port),
+		User:       params.Username,
+		Database:   params.DatabaseName,
+		Encryption: msdsn.EncryptionDisabled,
+		Protocols:  []string{"tcp"},
+	}, nil)
+	db := sql.OpenDB(connector)
+	defer db.Close()
+	return trace.Wrap(db.PingContext(ctx))
+}
+
+// IsConnectionRefusedError reports whether the server refused the connection.
+func (p *SQLServerPinger) IsConnectionRefusedError(err error) bool {
+	if err == nil {
+		return false
+	}
+	var opErr *net.OpError
+	if errors.As(err, &opErr) && strings.Contains(strings.ToLower(opErr.Error()), "connection refused") {
+		return true
+	}
+	return strings.Contains(strings.ToLower(err.Error()), "connection refused")
+}
+
+// IsInvalidDatabaseUserError reports an invalid SQL Server login.
+func (p *SQLServerPinger) IsInvalidDatabaseUserError(err error) bool {
+	if err == nil {
+		return false
+	}
+	var sqlErr mssql.Error
+	if errors.As(err, &sqlErr) {
+		if sqlErr.Number == 18456 || sqlErr.Number == 18452 {
+			return true
+		}
+		if sqlErr.Number != 28353 {
+			return false
+		}
+	}
+	message := strings.ToLower(err.Error())
+	return strings.Contains(message, "login failed for user") || strings.Contains(message, "database user") && strings.Contains(message, "does not exist")
+}
+
+// IsInvalidDatabaseNameError reports an invalid or inaccessible database.
+func (p *SQLServerPinger) IsInvalidDatabaseNameError(err error) bool {
+	if err == nil {
+		return false
+	}
+	var sqlErr mssql.Error
+	if errors.As(err, &sqlErr) {
+		switch sqlErr.Number {
+		case 4060, 911, 916:
+			return true
+		case 28353:
+		default:
+			return false
+		}
+	}
+	message := strings.ToLower(err.Error())
+	return strings.Contains(message, "cannot open database") || strings.Contains(message, "database") && strings.Contains(message, "does not exist")
+}

+package database
+
+import (
+	"context"
+	"errors"
+	"fmt"
+	"net"
+	"strconv"
+	"testing"
+	"time"
+
+	mssql "github.com/microsoft/go-mssqldb"
+	"github.com/stretchr/testify/require"
+
+	"github.com/gravitational/teleport/lib/srv/db/common"
+	"github.com/gravitational/teleport/lib/srv/db/sqlserver"
+)
+
+func TestSQLServerPing(t *testing.T) {
+	server, err := sqlserver.NewTestServer(common.TestServerConfig{AuthClient: setupMockClient(t)})
+	require.NoError(t, err)
+	go func() {
+		require.NoError(t, server.Serve())
+	}()
+	t.Cleanup(func() { require.NoError(t, server.Close()) })
+	port, err := strconv.Atoi(server.Port())
+	require.NoError(t, err)
+
+	ctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(context.Background(), 30*time.Second)
+	defer cancel()
+	p := SQLServerPinger{}
+	require.NoError(t, p.Ping(ctx, PingParams{Host: "localhost", Port: port, Username: "someuser", DatabaseName: "somedb"}))
+}
+
+func TestSQLServerPingValidationAndDeadline(t *testing.T) {
+	p := SQLServerPinger{}
+	for _, params := range []PingParams{
+		{Host: "localhost", Port: 1433, DatabaseName: "db"},
+		{Host: "localhost", Port: 1433, Username: "user"},
+		{Host: "localhost", Port: -1, Username: "user", DatabaseName: "db"},
+	} {
+		require.Error(t, p.Ping(context.Background(), params))
+	}
+	ctx, cancel := context.WithCancel(context.Background())
+	cancel()
+	require.ErrorIs(t, p.Ping(ctx, PingParams{Host: "localhost", Port: 1433, Username: "user", DatabaseName: "db"}), context.Canceled)
+}
+
+func TestSQLServerErrors(t *testing.T) {
+	p := SQLServerPinger{}
+	for _, tt := range []struct {
+		name                    string
+		err                     error
+		refused, user, database bool
+	}{
+		{name: "nil"},
+		{name: "refused", err: fmt.Errorf("dial: %w", &net.OpError{Err: errors.New("connection refused")}), refused: true},
+		{name: "invalid login", err: fmt.Errorf("connect: %w", mssql.Error{Number: 18456}), user: true},
+		{name: "invalid database", err: fmt.Errorf("connect: %w", mssql.Error{Number: 4060}), database: true},
+		{name: "teleport user", err: mssql.Error{Number: 28353, Message: "Login failed for user 'absent'"}, user: true},
+		{name: "teleport database", err: mssql.Error{Number: 28353, Message: "database does not exist"}, database: true},
+		{name: "other", err: mssql.Error{Number: 1234}},
+	} {
+		t.Run(tt.name, func(t *testing.T) {
+			require.Equal(t, tt.refused, p.IsConnectionRefusedError(tt.err))
+			require.Equal(t, tt.user, p.IsInvalidDatabaseUserError(tt.err))
+			require.Equal(t, tt.database, p.IsInvalidDatabaseNameError(tt.err))
+		})
+	}
+}
